data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1062 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1062), merged to main as cc2ce4032 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved).

Mechanism as implemented (grounded, differs from the ticket's original framing): plan-review blocking is default_posture 'blocking' + block_threshold 0.85 on the G7 routing entry (criteria/model.py threshold_for, gate='plan_review'; blocking_enabled is inert here). No per-grade Pass-3 gate exists or was added — kind scoping is the existing plan-v4 divergence grading (ADR 0054): contradicts_reality AND omits_required_site hard-floor impact at 0.85 and can block at high validity; incomplete_enumeration contributes 0.55 and can never reach the bar via the divergence axis. Restricting to contradicts_reality alone was rejected: it would need new cross-gate kernel machinery, the FP evidence (0 clearly-incorrect at >= 0.85 over all 348 historical findings, ticket 696a) is kind-blind, and ADR 0054 deliberately floors omits_required_site. Rubric gained FLOOR-KIND GUIDANCE, CLOSED-PARENT (final state + sibling handoff), DEDUP-AT-SOURCE (one finding per contradicted parent clause, the c97a T5c pattern — decide.py untouched), and FAIL-OPEN abstain-with-coverage on an unresolvable parent.

Tests: new tests/unit/plan_review/test_g7_blocking.py (real Pass-3 wrapper + real impact_plan, boundary case at priority 0.85, validity guard, rubric-text pins); all three pinned blocking-set assertions gained G7 (test_threshold_recalibration.py table + set via new G7_BLOCKING constant, test_impact_model_versioning.py approved set); test_plan_review_g7.py posture pin updated; criteria guide regenerated. Full tests/unit: 6089 passed, 19 skipped.

MONITORING FOLLOW-UP (not an AC, per the FP-verification conditions): re-run the FP classification once >= 20 kind-graded G7 findings have accumulated in the REVIEW_RESULT corpus (only 3 existed at enablement); the zero-LLM criterion-effectiveness recorder tracks blocking outcomes, same stance as the bfa8 pilot.
